title: Native widgets of the Reactive/Mobile context: content and layout widgets, form inputs, lists and tables, the native dropdown

capabilities.title: Content and layout widgets: container, text widget, expression widget, HTML element, icon, If widget, button, link, image widget
capabilities.summary: Native widgets created under an existing parent (a layout placeholder, a container, a placeholder content): IContainer (Style = CSS classes), ITextWidget (literal text; a button caption), IExpression (an OutSystems expression, never JavaScript), IAdvancedHtml (an HTML element by Tag), IIcon (Icon, Weight on ODC), IIfWidget (Condition; True/False branches born with it), IButton/ILink (their OnClick binding is an event), IImage (an image of the module by name, or an URL). Each is addressed by path (`IMobileScreen:<Screen>/<path>/<Widget>`, `#Type[n]`, `**Type[n]`).

route.operation: create {parent: <widget path>, type: IContainer|IExpression|IAdvancedHtml|IIcon|IIfWidget|IButton|ILink|IImage, name?, as}; set Style/Value/Tag/Icon/Condition/Text; move/duplicate/delete by path; or html-visual

depends.unless: the parent screen or block already exists (address it by path)

alternatives.when: several widgets are easier to write as an HTML fragment (div, text, {{ expr }}, i, button, a, img, div[if])

capabilities.guidance: Property names are read from the native contract of the installed Studio (--expand <id>:native) and from html-visual.tags, not curated here. A widget is born with default text (a button 'Button', a link 'Link'): set the caption on its ITextWidget child. Move only reorders inside the same parent; to reparent, create at the new parent and delete the old widget. Before deleting a widget, check usages (a Label's TargetWidget points at inputs).

preconditions: the parent is an existing container, placeholder or placeholder content of a screen or block
an icon needs Weight on ODC (html-visual rejects <i> without weight)

limits.text: A button's, link's or label's caption lives inside IContent on ODC: address it with `$btn/#ITextWidget` (the `#Type` search looks in IContent too).
A widget is born with default text and an icon needs Weight on ODC.
limits.origin: kernel/docs/NAO-DA.md 'Widget nasce com texto padrao' (CONFIRMED, C# route; no job)

limits.text: IIfWidget, ILink and the image widget have no ODC suite job: they are accepted by the verbs and by html-visual but not measured on this lane.
On O11 a button's caption sits beside the button (not inside IContent); `#ITextWidget` finds it in both lanes.

The Reactive widget contract tests (tests/contracts/screen-coverage, 51 reactive + 52 mobile cases: native Verify, reload, 3-way merge, rejected mutation) run outside the job suites; their evidence is not stamped with kernel/Studio identity and is historical here.

capabilities.title: Value widgets bound to a variable: textbox, checkbox, switch, textarea, radio, upload, button group
capabilities.summary: Value widgets bind a variable or an attribute path through `Variable` (IInput, ICheckbox, ISwitch, ITextArea, IRadioGroup, IButtonGroup; IUpload: FileContent/FileName); IForm groups them for validation; IRadioButton/IButtonGroupItem carry their `Value`; ILabel points at one of them with `TargetWidget`. Mandatory comes from the attribute or `set Mandatory True`. What `Variable` names is declared elsewhere and referenced by name.

depends.unless: the parent screen or block already exists (address it by path)

alternatives.when: input/checkbox/textarea/label written as an HTML fragment (bind names an existing variable)

capabilities.guidance: Bind to what exists: `Variable` names a local variable (`Name`) or an aggregate attribute (`GetX.List.Current.<Entity>.<Attr>`). A widget referenced by a Label's TargetWidget cannot be deleted before the label (usages lists it).

preconditions: radio buttons are created under their radio group, button group items under their button group

odc.note: the C# route drops the items created in a Content on save and no ODC job creates IButtonGroup (declared; see the unavailable entry button-group-native)

o11.scope: get of an input bound to the record

limits.text: Switch, text area, radio group/button and upload have no ODC suite job; button group items are dropped by the C# route (button-group-native).
Deleting an input refers back to its consumers: a Label's TargetWidget blocks the delete until the label goes.

capabilities.title: Lists, list items and TableRecords with item navigation
capabilities.summary: IScreenAggregate with ISort, IList with Source `GetX.List`, IListItem with expressions in its content, `set $item/OnClick Destination IMobileScreen:Detail` plus one argument Value per detail parameter; ITableRecords with Source and one IHeaderCell + IRowCell pair per column.

route.operation:
screen-list.json pattern: create IList + set Source; create IListItem; delete the example IListItemAction; or ITableRecords + IHeaderCell/IRowCell; or the fragment {"op":"html","parent":"","html":"
{{Order.Order.Number}}
\" as=\"Item\">{{Item.Name}}
"} (lists nest in the fragment; as names the row)

depends.unless: the screen already exists (place the list under IMobileScreen:Name/...)

alternatives.when: the list body is easier as `<div list as>` HTML

preconditions: a ListItem is born with an example swipe action without destination: delete `$item/RightActions/#IListItemAction`
the Source list must be in scope of the screen (a data action or aggregate of the same screen)

odc.scope: Source (screen-list); Style and AnimateItems of an inherited list (screen-block-edit)

o11.note: jobs-negative/dataaction-list-scope and structure-list-scope exercise out-of-scope list sources but declare no expectError, so they are not refusal proofs

odc.scope: get of an inherited list before and after Style/AnimateItems
the example swipe action born with the item

limits.text: A ListItem is born with an example swipe action without destination: delete `$item/RightActions/#IListItemAction`. On ODC the children of a List live inside an IContent (paths show IList:X/IContent:content/...).
limits.origin: job:screen-list; job:data-action usages note; kernel/docs/NAO-DA.md 'Filhos de uma IList' (line 806)

limits.text: ITableRecords (table with columns) has no ODC job; it is accepted by the verbs, measured on O11 only.
limits.origin: index: no ODC job creates ITableRecords

limits.text: The Source of a list must be a list in scope of the screen (a data action or aggregate of the same screen); jobs-negative/dataaction-list-scope and structure-list-scope exercise the out-of-scope case without a declared expectError (not counted as refusal proofs).

differences: list children directly under the list (no IContent)

capabilities.title: Native dropdown (IDropdown) bound to a list
capabilities.summary: Native IDropdown bound to an option list (List, Values, Labels) and to a variable or record field (Variable); EmptyValue (not Prompt) is the text of the empty option. The visual `html` op maps `<select>` to it. Its property names for the installed Studio are in the native contract (--expand ui.dropdown:native).

route.operation: create IDropdown under a container; set List/Values/Labels/Variable/EmptyValue with raw verbs; or the fragment {"op":"html","parent":"<widget path>","html":"<select bind=\"Var\" options=\"GetItems.List\" value=\"GetItems.List.Current.Item.Id\" label=\"GetItems.List.Current.Item.Label\"/>"} (never <option> elements)

depends.unless: the screen already exists (place the widget under IMobileScreen:Name/...)

capabilities.guidance: When the user must type to search, the answer on ODC is the OutSystemsUI DropdownSearch block (ui.dropdown-search), whose contract is the block signature in the module; the native dropdown has no search behaviour of its own.

preconditions: the empty option text is EmptyValue: `set Prompt` is refused and the refusal lists the writable expression properties

odc.scope: cat-b-widget-gallery: set List, Values, Labels, Variable (ops 39-41)

o11.note: set Prompt is exercised by jobs-negative/dropdown-prompt, which declares no expectError (not a refusal proof)

limits.text: No ODC job creates an IDropdown: the kernel accepts it (verbs + Model API) and it is proven on O11 (gallery-native-reactive.json, widgets-reactive.json); deliver it directly (studio_deliver validates the job on a fresh capture and refuses before any change); a headless proof (ssam_job) only when the person asks for one.
The native dropdown has no search behaviour of its own (O11 vocabulary: DropdownMode Text|Custom; confirm the ODC members with the native contract).
limits.origin: ScreenVocabulary.json (O11 11.55.69) IDropdown; ODC Model API index NRWidgets IDropdown

limits.text: IDropdown has EmptyValue, not Prompt (description of jobs-negative/dropdown-prompt: the kernel reports the writable expression properties); that job declares no expectError, so the refusal text is not recorded as a proof.

unavailable.reason: On ODC the native Button Group cannot be authored by the C# route (items created in a Content are silently dropped on save; the builder does not create ButtonGroupItem) and no ODC job creates IButtonGroup. On O11 it is proven by jobs (gallery-native-reactive, widgets-reactive): see ui.input.
